name: @hyxi/pi-openspec
description: OpenSpec agent skills and /opsx-* prompt templates for Pi, generated from @fission-ai/openspec at build time

scripts.smoke: node --input-type=module --eval "const fs = await import('node:fs/promises'); const skillDirs = await fs.readdir('dist/skills'); const skills = await Promise.all(skillDirs.map((d) => fs.readFile('dist/skills/' + d + '/SKILL.md', 'utf8'))); const prompts = (await fs.readdir('dist/prompts')).filter((f) => f.endsWith('.md')); const promptTexts = await Promise.all(prompts.map((f) => fs.readFile('dist/prompts/' + f, 'utf8'))); const frontmatter = (text, key) => text.startsWith('---') && text.split('\n---')[0].includes(key); const ok = skillDirs.length > 0 && skillDirs.length === prompts.length && prompts.every((f) => /^opsx-[a-z0-9-]+\.md$/.test(f)) && skills.every((s) => frontmatter(s, 'name: ') && frontmatter(s, 'description: ') && !s.includes('/opsx:')) && promptTexts.every((p) => frontmatter(p, 'description: ') && !p.includes('/opsx:')); if (!ok) process.exit(1)"
